beats.say: While Genie 4 delivers our highest-fidelity visuals, physics, and native audio, Genie 3 remains available in Project Genie’s model picker when you want longer runs or panorama-seeded spaces.
Genie 4 is now available Earlier this year we introduced Project Genie, an experimental research prototype that lets you generate and explore interactive worlds.
Genie 3 and Genie 4 remain world models in the frontier research space.
